description: CR-CH-078 -- Full arrow-key focus navigation in the SHARED ISPF table editor. Up/Down moves focus to the SAME column in the adjacent row (clamped at first/last row); Left/Right moves to the adjacent column within a row (clamped at first/last column); no wrap on either axis. The component OWNS the arrow walk and CONSUMES the arrow key (ui.input_mut consume_key) BEFORE egui traverses (the render_menu_bar/render_chrome B056-B059 pattern), then request_focus a stable same-frame id. Tab/Shift+Tab via the existing WorkspaceContext InteriorFocus latch and the stable egui ids the full-shell tests depend on are PRESERVED (additive). The Command ===> line keeps its CR-NR-096 Up/Down history gesture because the walk fires only when a MATRIX cell holds focus. Lives in the shared component so every host inherits it.
steps: RED: create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/arrow_nav.rs with a #[cfg(test)] mod tests of table-driven failing cases for a pure `fn arrow_target(rows: usize, cols: usize, cur: (usize, usize), dir: ArrowDir) -> (usize, usize)` and an ArrowDir enum: Down (0,c)->(1,c); Up (0,c)->(0,c) clamp; Down (last,c)->(last,c) clamp; Right (r,0)->(r,1); Left (r,0)->(r,0) clamp; Right (r,last)->(r,last) clamp; no wrap. Annotate // Validates: ispf-table-editor Requirement 11.1/11.2. Add `pub(crate) mod arrow_nav;` to mod.rs.
GREEN: implement arrow_target + ArrowDir (saturating add/sub, clamp to rows-1 / cols-1, no wrap). Keep the file small.

Extend the egui-aware IspfTableRender contract so the surface can obtain a row's focusable cell ids in visual order (prefer returning the fresh same-frame ids from the row render so they round-trip through focus -- the B056 lesson that a guessed combo id fails). Implement it on AliasEditorState in alias_editor_panel/host.rs using the row_control_id(prefix, backing) ids from rows.rs (alias_act/alias_surface/alias_template/alias_description) plus the CE/Root combo ids captured from their responses.

GREEN: in render_ispf_table (render.rs) assemble a Vec<Vec<egui::Id>> field matrix as rows are drawn; after layout read ui.ctx().memory(|m| m.focused()); if it is a matrix cell (and NOT command_line_id()), for each pressed Up/Down/Left/Right CONSUME it with ui.input_mut(|i| i.consume_key(egui::Modifiers::NONE, key)), compute the target with arrow_nav::arrow_target, and ui.ctx().memory_mut(|m| m.request_focus(target_id)). Do nothing when the command line holds focus (preserve the CR-NR-096 history gesture, Req 11.5). Keep render.rs under 400 non-test lines -- move the walk into arrow_nav.rs as apply_arrow_walk(...) if needed.

GREEN: add a full-shell egui_kittest test in tests_focus.rs (harness as in the Act-cell test): seed two+ rows; request_focus(("alias_act", 0)); key_press(ArrowDown) -> focus is ("alias_act", 1); key_press(ArrowDown) on the last row -> focus unchanged (clamp); request_focus(("alias_act", 0)); key_press(ArrowRight) -> focus moves to the next column cell in row 0. Annotate // Validates: ispf-table-editor Requirement 11.1, 11.2, 11.3.
Regression: do NOT change the stable ids. Confirm the existing first-Tab and in-Act-cell tests still pass (Req 11.4).
acceptance_criteria: arrow_target is pure and table-tested: clamps at all four edges with no wrap (Req 11.1, 11.2).

In the full-shell harness, ArrowDown from a row's Act cell focuses the Act cell of the next row; ArrowDown on the last row leaves focus unchanged; ArrowRight moves to the next column in the row; all consumed before egui so no stray traversal.
The arrow walk never fires while the Command ===> line holds focus (history gesture intact).

Tab/Shift+Tab, the reported InteriorFocus anchors, and every stable egui id are unchanged: full_shell_alias_editor_first_tab_focuses_first_interior and full_shell_alias_editor_enter_in_act_cell_applies_line_command still pass.
The behaviour lives in the shared component (not bolted onto the Alias panel).
findings:
Implemented CR-CH-078 in the SHARED component. New file crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/arrow_nav.rs: pure fn arrow_target(rows, cols, cur, dir) -> (usize, usize) + ArrowDir enum (saturating add/sub, clamp to rows-1/cols-1, NO wrap, degenerate matrix returns cur) and apply_arrow_walk(ui, matrix, focused) which drains Up/Down/Left/Right via ui.input_mut(consume_key(Modifiers::NONE, key)) BEFORE egui traverses and request_focus the clamped target cell; it no-ops when the focused id is not a matrix cell. mod.rs: added `pub(crate) mod arrow_nav;` and re-exports.

Contract change (additive): IspfTableRender::render_row_cells now returns a new struct render::RowCells { act_enter: bool, cell_ids: Vec<egui::Id> } instead of bare bool. The surface (render.rs) assembles a Vec<Vec<egui::Id>> field matrix row-major in VISUAL order from the FRESH same-frame ids each row reports, then after layout reads ui.ctx().memory(focused) and, when it is NOT command_line_id(), calls apply_arrow_walk. The Command ===> history gesture (CR-NR-096, Req 11.5) is preserved by skipping the walk when the command line holds focus.

Alias host: rows.rs render_data_row returns RowCells with cell_ids in order [alias_act, CE combo id, Root combo id, alias_surface, alias_template, alias_description]; the two combo ids are captured FRESH from their egui::Response (render_root_combo now returns egui::Id) rather than guessed (B056 lesson). Stable ids UNCHANGED.

IMPORTANT for later steps: cell_ids ORDER is the visual/Tab order and is what the arrow matrix columns map to; a host adding columns must append ids in visual order. RowCells is the new per-row return type any future host (Menu/Kinds) must produce. apply_arrow_walk uses the FOCUSED cell's own row length for `cols`, so ragged rows clamp against their own width.

Verification (all GREEN, logs in worktree _ignore/logs/): cargo check -p ff-desktop (clean); cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings (clean); cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check (no diff); cargo test -p ff-desktop arrow_target (9 passed); cargo test -p ff-desktop full_shell_alias_editor (5 passed, incl. the new full_shell_alias_editor_arrow_down_and_right_walk_the_matrix and the two regression tests full_shell_alias_editor_first_tab_focuses_first_interior + full_shell_alias_editor_enter_in_act_cell_applies_line_command). All touched .rs under 400 non-test lines. Did NOT run the full gate (owner-only).
